ITEM 1 | Scrambled egg, pale yellow to golden with darker yellow patches, soft and fluffy with curds, slightly moist, irregular clumps spread across the upper right of the plate covering roughly 35% of the plate area, about 2 cm thick in the heap | 150
ITEM 2 | Small cylindrical sausage pieces, medium brown with browned and slightly charred outer surface, firm and glossy with light sheen, cut into rounds about 2 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, roughly 18 pieces clustered in the lower left of the plate covering about 25% of the plate area, about 1.5 cm high | 130
